$comment: Known iGaming bugs injected in the `with-bugs` target of the Baccarat table & seamless wallet server. Each bug is detected by an automated test case and documented in a GitHub Issue with screenshot/log evidence.

title.zh-TW: 補牌規則錯誤：莊家 3 點且閒家第三張牌為 8 時，莊家誤補第三張牌
title.en: Third-card tableau bug: Banker on 3 erroneously draws when Player's third card is 8

title.zh-TW: 和局結算錯誤：開出和局（Tie）時未退還莊、閒主注本金（Push），直接當輸局沒收
title.en: Tie settlement bug: Tie outcome forfeits Player and Banker main bets instead of pushing

title.zh-TW: 莊贏 5% 抽水精度錯誤：1:0.95 派彩直接無條件捨去小數點，吃掉玩家美分派彩
title.en: Banker 5% commission bug: 1:0.95 payout truncates fractional dollars via Math.floor

title.zh-TW: 對子邊注判定錯誤：首兩張同點數但不同花色（如 ♠K + ♥K）時漏判對子未派彩
title.en: Pair side-bet bug: mixed-suit pairs of the same rank (e.g. ♠K + ♥K) are not paid

title.zh-TW: 高併發錢包漏洞：同時發送多筆全額下注時未加互斥鎖，導致超額扣款產生負餘額
title.en: Wallet race condition: concurrent all-in bets bypass session locking and overdraw into negative balance

title.zh-TW: 冪等性失效：網路重試送出相同 idempotencyKey 的注單時被重複扣款
title.en: Idempotency failure: duplicate bet retries with the same idempotencyKey charge the wallet multiple times

title.zh-TW: 關盤後偷下注漏洞：桌台狀態已進入 BETTING_CLOSED，直接呼叫 API 仍可成功塞單
title.en: Late bet vulnerability: POST /api/bets still accepts wagers after table state is BETTING_CLOSED

title.zh-TW: 牌靴發牌權重偏差：閒家異常高比例拿到天牌 9，導致 10 萬局實測閒家 RTP 飆破 110%
title.en: Biased shoe RNG: Player receives excess Natural 9 hands, pushing 100k-round Player RTP above 110%

category.zh-TW: 真人視訊串流與硬體洗牌機（Live Studio WebRTC / Physical Shoe Scanner）
category.en: Live studio video streaming and physical shoe scanner hardware

reason.zh-TW: 本專案聚焦於遊戲規則引擎、賠率結算、單一錢包併發帳務與 RTP 數學模型驗證，不包含視訊串流延遲測試。
reason.en: This suite targets the rules engine, payout math, seamless wallet concurrency, and RTP statistical verification rather than WebRTC video latency.

category.zh-TW: 多幣別匯率轉換與第三方支付閘道（Multi-Currency FX & Payment Gateway）
category.en: Multi-currency FX conversion and third-party payment gateway

reason.zh-TW: 單一錢包以標準 USD（美分整數精度）驗證帳變與冪等性，不依賴外部匯率服務。
reason.en: The seamless wallet validates ledger accuracy and idempotency in USD cents without external FX feeds.
